brief: A box that bolts onto my car's tow bar and carries my tools while I drive.

requirements.evidence: 3-piece cluster (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) with bins bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div3, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2, lids and caps, meshClash clear.

No tow-bar / hitch / towball mount exists in find_parts (hitch, tow, car searches empty). Built 2x hex-acc-bracket L-brackets as generic bolt-on flats, but no part attaches to a car tow bar and configurator never verified fit to a tow bar.

Divided bins provide compartments; staged heap-screws-div3 and heap-nuts-div3 props in bin:0,1,0. Other tool props refused (PROP_NO_REST overlap) and cover closed over them; brackets added required removing caps so box is open on two side faces.

Configurator checks only fit and collisions, not strength, vibration, load rating, retention under driving, weatherproofing, or road legality. 3D-printed material safety unknown. Cannot certify tools stay inside while driving; build currently needs re-capping and has split groups.
requirements.requirement: safe to carry tools while driving

finish.summary: Built a small lidded 3-cell divided-bin box with L-bracket bolt-on points as a stand-in for tow-bar mounting, staged with small fastener props. No tow-bar interface exists in the system so true tow-bar bolting and drive-rated retention/strength are unmet.

parts.name: Port plug
parts.use: Blanks a side port you are not using, so a cell that is closed up looks finished and nothing gets in through a hole you left open.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.

parts.name: Port screen
parts.use: Passes air and keeps insects and debris out, so a cell can breathe through an opening that is still covered.

parts.name: Port hose barb
parts.use: Lands a hose on a cell, so water arrives and leaves through a spigot drawn for it rather than over an edge.

parts.name: Port cable plate
parts.use: Leads cable through a side port on finished holes, so wiring enters a closed cell through something drawn for it and each run has its own way in.

parts.name: L bracket
parts.use: Back plate on the flat, shelf on top, gusset underneath: the part to bolt on when something has to stick out sideways and stay level.
